text.value: You wanted to see me, Grandma?
It's time for you to find out what’s behind that locked door in my garden wall.
Take this key and open the door!
I can't believe it! How long have I been asking about that door? Twenty years?
Now Grandma’s finally given me the key! Let's go open the gate!
Got it! It opened!
A mansion!? What other secrets are you hiding, Grandma?
We can't reach the front door.
Maybe we can use something in that garage to get there.
What a mess! Let's merge these boxes to make more room.
What a mess! Let's merge these barrels to make more room.
What a mess! Let's Merge these barrels to make more room.
Great! Now let's merge these two.
Great! Now let's Merge these two.
We can clean up dusty boxes by merging them. Try merging these two!
We can clean up dusty barrels by merging them. Try merging these two!
A barrel of garden tools! Maybe there's something in there we can use. Tap it to find out!
These might come handy! Tap to see what else is in the box!
A gardening glove! If we find a pair, we can use these to clear a path to the mansion!
Almost there. Merge it one more time.
We found a pair! Let's go clean up the driveway!
We found a pair! Let's go clean the driveway!
This looks great. Thank you!
It’s not a big deal. Buildings that are in bad shape are my area of expertise.
Would you like to get a cup of-
What was that noise?!
I’m sorry I didn’t know the gear was in reverse.
Are you ok?
I think so.
Better make sure. My Grandma lives right around the corner.
I know, that’s where I came from.
What?
I mean that is the direction I came from.
I’m sorry. Now the gate is damaged and the car is broken.
Maybe my friend Roddy can help with that while I take you to grandma’s.
Thank you for your help.
I just wanted to restore the family estate to its former glory!
I should be going.
Make sure your gear is not in reverse.
Point taken.
What do you mean by that?!
A chest! It takes a while to open them, so you'd best start on it now.
Let's see what else is in the box.
Let's Merge these garden knives to get a Garden Fork.
Let's get another garden fork. Let's try to Merge these knives.
Another garden fork! Let's merge these garden forks.
Another garden fork! Let's Merge these garden forks.
Pruning shears! There must be an axe somewhere in here. Let's merge these shears.
Pruning shears! There must be an axe somewhere in here. Let's Merge these shears.
There's an axe! Now we can chop up that log!
Let's see if there are more gloves in the barrel!
Let's see if there are more Gloves in the barrel!
Gardening gloves! First to the door gets all the marbles!
There's someone at the gate. Did we get our first guest already?
Hello there! I'm Roddy Took, Building Inspector.
This is a wonderful old house you have here, but I’m afraid to say it has to come down.
What!? But we only just opened the gate!
I’m sorry, but the city's regulations don't allow for dangerous buildings. Health and safety first and foremost.
But...
Between you and me, I can mark you down as “improving” when I come back if you just tidy up the front here.
That will buy you some time before the bulldozers move in...
So if we fix the place up, the city won’t tear it down?
That’s about the size of it, yes.
You heard the man – let’s get to work!
There's someone in the driveway again. What now?
This looks spectacular!
Do you really think so?
When I show them at the office what you've done here, they're definitely going to want to see more.
Yeah, I've been really worried about the council. Do you think I'm doing enough to restore the estate?
Oh! Of course! I'm sure you are. The place looks much better already. I'll go there and see if I can dig anything up, though.
Let's get to work, then!
There's someone in the driveway. I think I know who...
I can see you’ve been very busy! But the more you clear, the more I can see that this place is enormous! Have you thought about calling in some help?
It's, well, it's because of Ursula. My friend said people there are talking about her 'dangerous past' - and her arrest.
Now that you mention it... That's a good idea. It has been a lot of work!
Yeah, about the arrest - who exactly did you show the photo of the gold watch to?
Uh, just people around town, like you asked me to! Maybe, you know, the police, in case it was missing.
I see. That gold watch was the reason she was arrested, Roddy.
Oh no! Maddie, you must know I never meant anything bad to happen to her.
Dress to impress, right? Let's get to it, then!
That there is your ancestor, Ignatius Montague Boulton, born on Christmas Day in 1802. He built this mansion.
Him? That's Ignatius Montague Boulton. He's the one who built this place and made the family fortune.
I lived here, yes, but none of us could really claim it was ours...
But Grandma, what does that mean?!
Hadn't you better get this fixed up for that building inspector of yours? He's kinda cute, ain't he?
Shouldn't you get this fixed up for that building inspector of yours? He's kinda cute, ain't he?
Great! I want to learn all about Grandpa Charlie, and my parents, and...
Some secrets are best left buried, Maddie. I'm off to bake.
She's hiding something! I just wish I knew what it was - and why!
Grandpa Ignatius hasn't looked so good since they built this place, I bet.
When I was a kid, I used to think this statue of Ignatius could see you, wherever you were in the gardens.
Ignatius Boulton built an empire out of tin cans. He was the first man in America to can goods. And the customers came running.
Not likely! Just made it all the more fun. You know, your Grandpa Charlie idolized Ignatius Boulton.
All good questions! Now give me a moment, I can hear the cat shredding my curtains again. Mingus! Get out of those drapes!
He was the first person in America to can goods. It revolutionized the food industry!
Grandma!!!
A few days ago I didn't even know I had a family legacy, and now I find out I come from a tin can empire?
That’s a pretty cool fountain!
Ignatius was a self-made man. He built his empire from nothing. This fountain is one of the many gifts he received.
An empire? An empire of what?!
Anyway, I'd love to hear about this fountain. What's the story?
Now hold that thought, my dear. I've got a cherry pie cooling and a cat that will eat anything that's not steaming!
Huh. Grandma's definitely deflecting, and I want to know why!
Ever get the feeling Grandma bakes just to avoid difficult questions?
They used to call Ignatius the Tin Man.
Because he didn't have a heart?
No, Ignatius had more heart than a lion.
Tin Man, empire... He wasn't doing anything illegal, right?
Ask me again a little later. I can see the postman coming up the street.
Is it me or is Grandma avoiding my questions?
Wow, a giant frog!
My grandfather said it came from Japan, a gift to Ignatius.
Who would send him gifts from that far away?!
We used to kiss it under the chin for good luck. I bet if you climb up there, you can see where we kissed it.
Oh, that question of yours. Can this wait? I have a pecan pie on a cooling rack.
Whoops! I've gotta run. My online knitting club starts in a few minutes!
She is so trying to avoid my questions...
I first met Grandpa Charlie right here beneath this frog.
You met him in the garden?
He climbed the wall right there and came and sat down next to me by the edge of the pool.
I was so surprised to see his head appear over the top of the wall, I didn’t know what to say!
It was like a fairy tale. He was my very own frog prince...
... don't you have a pie in the oven or something?
What was this space all about? It's nothing like a grand mansion.
This was where Skatie Katie and Hang Ten hung out. Their little slice of paradise.
Skatie, Hang.. Grandma, are you feeling okay? This is making less and less sense.
Katie 'Skatie' Boulton, my dear older cousin. She fell madly in love with Casey 'Hang Ten' Schultz.
Katie "Skatie" Boulton, my dear older cousin. She fell madly in love with Casey "Hang Ten" Schultz.
You have a cousin? Grandma, now you have to tell me everything!
Not now, honey, the cat’s waiting for her bath.
If I ever needed a reason to think my family was weird...
What's with all of these surfboards?
Casey was one of the most famous surfers back in the day. He was looking for big waves. He was a legend.
But there are no waves here. This is the calmest part of the sea I know!
Katie and Casey fell in love, and she brought him here. Casey was looking for the fabled Perfect Wave that never came.
There must be a happy ending in here somewhere, right?
I can’t answer that right now! Not without first pouring myself a mint julep. Back in a swish!
In fact, I don't think I want to talk about it right now. Sorry, Maddie.
Alright, mind blown! So he was a surfer, she was a roller skater, and they came together and made skateboards?
That's right, sweetie. Cousin Katie always said they invented the skateboard.
Invented the skateboard? You're kidding, right?
I don't know about that, but every surfer who came here looking for Casey showed up with a surfboard and left with a skateboard..
This makes sense after all! Grandma, for a moment I was worried about you. So, I had this question about..
Oh my gosh! I left the bath running! And I put an extra dollop of bubbles in!
But you don’t have a bath!
That's quite the car! Or was, I guess?
It belonged to Lindsay Boulton. She almost drove the family bankrupt.
We're finally getting to the meat of the story! So she was the guilty one who partied all day and night?
Actually she made a fortune for the family. She quadrupled our family's wealth in only seven years. But then she lost all of it and then some.
So is that why the mansion was sealed off?
I’d love to stay and chat, but I really must be off – I’ve got a costume party to go to, and I’ve got to wrap myself head to toe in bandages.
That excuse wasn’t a patch on the last one!
Before you have to run off again: is Lindsay the reason the mansion was sealed off?
Lindsay was heartbroken when she came back to Beaumont Hall. She swore never to set foot in New York again.
But canned goods were in high demand during the downturn. The family business recovered slowly but surely.
All of a sudden Lindsay had a stroke of genius. She came up with a new invention: the spray can.
That made the family business really boom. Business had never been so good.
Do you mean Lindsay wasn't why the mansion was sealed off?
Oh my! I think I put my hat in the oven and my cake on the hook! Gotta go!
Should I tell her some of her cakes taste like hats?
And not the first person trying to save this old estate, either...
So Lindsay made money and lost money. What did she do exactly?
Lindsay was a canny investor. She moved to New York with a bag of Boulton money to make it big on Wall Street.
She was a really successful investor. But she couldn't predict the stock market crash in 1929.
She lost all her money and then some. That broke her heart, and she moved back to Beaumont Hall.
Oh my gosh! I hate to sound like a broken record, but is that why the mansion was sealed off??
Can I answer that later? I’ve got to go chase a blue jay out of the greenhouse. Darn thing keeps eating my raspberries.
That’s a pretty statue. Must have cost a lot. Tell me more about Ignatius and his tin cans.
Tinned food was a miraculous invention back then. No one had fridges. Ignatius saw how much demand there was as soon as he sold his first can.
One can started this whole thing off? How did he turn it into an empire, then?!
Now I can’t stand here all day gossiping. Mr. Pinkerton will be here soon. He’s taking me for a ride in his jalopy.
A jalopy? Isn’t that some kind of chili pepper?
Oh my, I just remembered! I pushed your grandfather into that pool once!
Huh? Why? Were you mad at him?
Oh, no. It's just that I saw my mother coming. No one knew about Charlie and me back then. He was a poor carpenter's son from the wrong side of town, you see.
Did that matter?
It did in those days. We thought if anyone caught us hanging out together, then they'd surely put an end to our courtship. That’s why we never went in the house.
Grandpa Charlie never went inside the mansion?!
You keep on talking, I’ll be back in a minute. I came out without my reading glasses and can’t hear a word you’re saying!
Um... okay...

Merging gives you more XP. Always Merge if you can!
Beaumont Hall? Why did Grandma keep this place a secret?
Your grandfather and I spent a lot of time in these gardens...
Was this Grandpa Charlie’s home???
Well, Charlie knew these grounds better than most, but they sure didn’t belong to him...
Grandma, what’s with all the mystery?
Not now, sweetie, I left a pie in the oven! And it looks like you've got your work cut out for you, too!
Huh? What do you mean?
Never mind. Alright, we can stay awhile. Just - watch where you dig, won't you?
Never mind. Alright, we can stay awhile. Just - watch where you dig, will you?
Oh well. I guess we should get the driveway cleaned before the inspector returns.
We can now sell items we don't need. Check out the item information bar. Be careful not to sell items you might want to keep!
Drag this piece of watermelon on top of the mixer to start the production.
Drag this item on top of another dusty item to unlock it.
Who's there?
Did you hear that the city is organising a Halloween challenge?
I did! I’m going to win that one!
City officials will do some evaluation rounds as part of that and --
And do you think they’ll also evaluate my progress with the mansion renovation?
Exactly. Better clean things up a bit.
At least those spider webs should go.
A hidden staircase?! Wonder where it leads...
Why do I hear barking? We don't have a dog... And this one sounds like it's in a tunnel!
What's that noise? It sounds like a dog - but I can't see one around. I'd better investigate.
It seems to be coming from here... Oh, no! The dog's stuck in the well!
It's definitely a dog - and it's coming from this old well! I'd better help the poor thing out.
Yay, you're free!
You don't look like you belong to anyone... Hmm... No collar or tag.
Hello boy! Do you have a name? I don't see a collar or tag on you.
Well, I've always wanted a dog... I guess I'll call you Rufus!
Huh. I guess you don't have an owner. Would you like to join me here? And can I call you Rufus?
Oo, a little dog! And you named it Rufus! How cute. As long as you don't eat my pies, we'll get along just fine.
Ruff!
I don't think dogs eat pies, Grandma.
Rufus, was it? Well, I suppose there's room here for another family member - as long as he doesn't dig anything up.
Yeah, well, guilty until proven innocent, if you ask me.
He won't do that, Grandma.
Ruff, ruff!
I hope not. He's cute, but I don't want him... disturbing anything.
Time for Winter Holiday decorations, grandma!
Work before play, Maddie. Our garage could use some cleaning.
But my old back is so sore today…
Don’t worry! I can do the cleaning!
Ah, I knew I could trust you! Have fun!
Pretty quick exit for someone with a sore back!
Well, let’s start with those dusty curtains!
A Ladder?! Where do those lead...
This garage has an attic!!!
I can’t remember the last time I climbed up here. It must--
Wasn’t your back sore, grandma?
...It must have been Christmas 1979, when we organised the Holiday Ball for the last time.
Holiday Ball? Was that the Boulton’s Christmas tradition you have talked about?
Yes, the whole village came over. The decorated mansion was like a palace from a storybook!
Wow!! Maybe your decorations are still here – let’s look around!
Who’s this fella, Maddie? Your new boyfriend?
Roddy, you know I’m still dating Mr. A.
Mr. A? Who... I didn’t know that you--
Just kidding!! I’ve always preferred cool guys like... these two.
Haha… Ok, well I'd better go build one for myself too!
So, how did my gingerbread cookies do?
I have never seen a gingerbread house this big!!
It would be even bigger if you didn’t eat most of the cookie dough!
Grandma! You know cookie dough is my guilty Christmas pleasure!
Christmas lights, Christmas vibes!
Those lanterns also make a nice runway for Santa’s sleigh.
That’s true! Did you wish for something special from Santa this year?
I guess my only wish is an impossible one. Even for Santa.
Really? What can be so hard to get?
Oh that penguin and I go a loooong way…
I think it makes a nice decoration!
It does! Although we originally used it for smuggling… candy.
Speaking of which, I'd better go and make sure we have some for Christmas.
Smuggling candy? Inside a penguin? There’s something fishy here…
These decorations will make the postman happy!
Oh there are already some Christmas postcards for me!
And dozens for grandma?! Who would send so many postcards to her?
And why did they put a ‘Confidential’ stamp on each of them...
Impressive Christmas tree decorations, Maddie!
Thank you! Do you already have a Christmas tree at your place?
Not yet! But I definitely should get one!
Although I have no one to dance around it with...
I’m sure you’ll find a dancing partner before Christmas!
Yes, well… I was thinking that maybe--
Oh I forgot to water the spruce! Where was that watering can again...
Ruff ruff!
What is it, Rufus? Don’t you like reindeers?
Woof…
Don’t worry! You will always be my favorite pet <3
WOOOOF!! <3
Gifts are the best thing about Christmas!
Or maybe it’s food. Or snow.
Speaking of which… Whose footsteps are in the snow?
Either grandma’s new shoes are way too big, or someone’s playing a trick on me...
Wooow… A White Christmas would be so magical to experience…
That’s true! It’s so romantic when the snow falls quietly.
When we had to escape to the North for a while, snow was actually pretty comforting.
You escaped to the North? When, why??
Oh, I mean… We paid a little visit there, yes.
Now I’ll pay a little visit to our neighbors, to borrow some sugar.
Grandma!! You can’t run away from these questions forever...
“Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way!”
“Oh what fun it is to ride, in a one-horse open sleigh--”
Hey?! These bells have old carvings… It says trait-- traitor??
Oh... those carvings are--
...Probably just some joke by the locals! Haha!
Locals had a weird sense of humour, if that’s true...
Knock knock!
Who’s there?
Oh, Chris!
Oh, Chris who?
“O Christmas tree! O Christmas tree! How lovely are thy branches!"
“O Grandma jokes, o grandma jokes, how passé are they every year… "
Oh, did you hang that mistletoe for someone special?
Mistletoe? What? No no no...
That inspector gentleman is very handsome indeed.
You mean Roddie? What are you saying grandma…
I’ll leave you to it! Just keep on decorating with love!
Grandma!!
Wow… I can’t believe that’s the same gate I ran over with my car!
I’m glad you like it! Are you here to see grandma?
Oh, Ursula? Yes, but just stopping by to wish her a merry Christmas!
Hmm… Could that explain why she was so excited this morning?
Well, it’s exciting to meet a good friend, right? I'd better go now.
Where did you find grandpa Charlie’s Christmas sweater?
It was tossed in with the decorations. Is it really grandpa Charlie’s?
Yes, we had similar ones. We used to wear them every Christmas until…
Until? Until what?
I must go check on the turkey in the oven.
You always leave me hanging!
Roddy, what do you think about this pool house? I'm considering making it into a party area.
I've been thinking about turning this old pool house into a party area!
You mean your grandmother's ready to open up the place to guests?
That sounds amazing! You're doing great things around here, Maddie.
Well, not exactly... But maybe I can convince her?
I'm not sure Grandma agrees with you.
I wish Grandma hadn't kept this whole place a secret so long. And I wish she'd open it up now.
She kept this place a secret for so long, and although she agreed to stay here with me, she doesn't seem happy about it.
Have you tried telling her what you told me, about feeling lonely as a child? She might understand...
Have you tried telling her what you told me, about feeling lonely as a child? She might understand.
You know, Roddy? You're right––I probably should have a heart-to-heart with her.
Do you think so? We've never really had a heart-to-heart, Grandma and I...
Sounds like a plan. I've got to get back to work, but good luck with Ursula, Maddie.
I don't know why she's kept secrets from you, Maddie, but it's obvious that she loves you.
Thanks, Roddy. I'll need it!
I'm sure if you talk to her she'll open up - and maybe even serve you some of that delicious pie of hers!
Now is as good a time as any. I need to find my grandmother so we can have a talk...
I can only hope! Thanks, Roddy. You've inspired me.
There's no time like the present - I'm going to go and find Grandma now so I can talk to her!
...Wow!
So, what's been going on here?
Maddie's really outdone herself here!
What do you mean, what's been going on?! Grandma, I just had to bail you out of the police station!
What do you mean? What's going on?! Grandma, I just had to bail you out of jail!
Seeing the place restored to its former glory really takes me back...
What happened? Why were you arrested?!
I was sure I would be the one to woo Ursula, but that Charlie...
I don't want to talk about it.
He just came in and swept her off her feet.
But I'll tell you this - someone betrayed your trust, Maddie.
But the truth is, I never stopped loving her...
Valentine’s Day! Yay! Another good reason for garden decorations!
That’s right, sweetheart. But work before play!
The garden would look so beautiful if the side gate would be polished.
But I’m already a bent, old woman…
Don’t worry, grandma! I can clean the gate!
Wow, this is not an ordinary gate! What’s behind it…
Whose love nest is this, grandma??
Oh me and… well you know, those are such good memories!
I know? Does that mean it used to be yours and grandpa Char--
I’m sorry, I really need to check on those cookies now.
Cookies!! Well of course!
Not the first time I smell a mystery…
And roses! Let's check if there are any romantic garden decorations for Valentine's Day!
Your decorations make me wish every day was Valentine’s Day!
Thanks! Maybe your wish will come true when you find a valentine for life!
I think I have found her, Maddie…
That’s lovely! Do I know the lucky girl?
Oh, haha! Yes, you do! You know her very well, because she--
Sorry Roddy, but WHAT is grandma doing THERE?! I gotta go!!
On days like these, life’s like a bed of roses!
Speaking of which… Some of my roses have been plucked!
Either grandma has her heritage vase filled with them…
…Or then someone else is preparing for Valentine's Day! Who could it be?
I love these lamps! I can already feel the romance in the air!
Are you planning on romancing that good looking building inspector?
Grandma! I told you we’re just friends…
If you don’t make a move on him, maybe I will!
No! No! No no no! Please grandma, don’t spur my imagination like that!!
Maybe I’ll get struck by Cupid’s arrow this Valentine’s da--
OUCH!!! What was that?
HAHAHAHA!
Grandma! I didn’t mean it THAT literally…
Haha! Don’t worry, it was just a toy arrow this time! Hope it makes you lucky in love!
Are those Ursula’s roses?
I guess they are! I planted them for Valentine’s Day!
Valentine's Day! Of course! I totally forgot to get flowers for your grandma…
You can pick a few from here if you like!
Oh wow! Thanks, but I’ll pass… These roses might remind her of those stormy times with--
Oh my, I really shouldn’t talk about that. See you around!
Wait!! Grandma had stormy times with who?!
Wow, you’re going all-in with Valentine’s Day decorations!
Thank you! I’m trying my bes--
The handsome inspector gentleman will be amazed by your dinner setting!
Grandma!! I’ve told you many times that we--
I know, I know, you’re taking it slow.
Just don’t let him slip away…
There’s some kind of a package at the gate…
Oooh!! It's a beautiful bouquet of flowers and chocolates!
Who is it from? There’s no card to go with it…
Woof woof!
Rufus! Did you just eat my Valentine’s card?
Woooof!
I guess my secret admirer will remain a secret for a while…
Love is in the air!
Wow! Beautiful heart-shaped balloons, Maddie!
Thank you! Do you want one?
Oh, I didn’t expect to find my way to your heart like this!
WHAT??
Oh, I meant---
I meant I gladly accept one balloon from you, my friend and friend only.
Sometimes you’re hard to read, Roddy…
Roses are red, violets are blue…
…flowers are sweet and they brighten up my mood!
That’s… a great version too!
I’m not sure if I love anything more than flowers!
Maybe one day!
Pink pink pink! Pink is the new black!
It’s my favourite colour for one day every year
And for the remaining 364 days, I’ll go for yellow, of course!
Hearts here, hearts there, hearts everywhere!
Well, that’s an impressive confession of love!
Who’s the lucky one?
Oh, no one special! Just spreading happiness around the neighbourhood!
Apologies! Ursula just said you were dating some handsome buil–
Building inspector! Of course, she said that!
I’m almost starting to think she knows something that I don’t…
Well, it wouldn't be the first time, right?
Hi Maddie! I would need some directions…
Directions? To where?
To your heart!
WHAT??
JOKING! I was joking, of course… Sorry!
Oh, I thought you would really--
Well, I’ll go check on grandma. See you around!
Damn! I really messed that one up, didn’t I…
A statue with a chocolate box in its hand – I’m a genius!
Just be careful that no one steals it!
What? Why would someone steal chocolate?
It’s not the chocolate I’m worried about but the di–
Oh well, maybe I’m worrying for nothing!
Dinner? Diary? Diapers?? What were you about to say, grandma…
Let's clear this up so we can start saving the estate! First, we need tools to clear a path in...
Oh, apologies. It really isn't my place to say. I must dash - it's time for my online yoga class.
And I must start repairing the garage. With all of these unexpected guests coming and going it would be a good idea to have a proper garage.
I wonder what Ignatius Boulton did to deserve a statue?
There's so much history here, and I don't know any of it!
Don't worry about his history right now - worry about his stone can! It's missing!
If he's missing a stone can, I should look for it! But why does he have one?
Find it and I'll tell you, dearie.
I need to fix up this sign, then I can finish the beach.
I'd like to find out more about Skatie Katie and Casey, too.
If Grandma won't tell me anything, then I should look around here for clues!
After this incident, it feels like I should check what's inside the Garage.
I know this old car is a beauty, but there's something missing. Can you spot it?
Huh... no! What is it?
I'll give you a clue - look at the car hood!
Car hood? Can't you just tell me what it is I’m looking for?
I'm sure you'll figure it out, dear!
Hmmm... That’s strange. There are just bare bricks here.
Wait a minute! Is it a sealed entrance? It must have led inside the Mansion!
But why is it sealed..?
And most importantly, by whom??
What is this?! A trunk!
Looks pretty old. I wonder what’s inside...
More family secrets, I bet!
Let's see what's inside this trunk. Whoa! It's filled with valuable items…
Let's see what's inside this trunk. Whoa! It's filled with valuable items...
Hey! These must all be something Mr. Winston stole from the Mansion!
I cannot believe it!
I should put everything back where it belongs.
Well… I’m not sure where exactly everything belongs… but I’m sure going to try!
Well... I’m not sure where exactly everything belongs... but I’m sure going to try!
There! All done! Grandma’s going to be so happy to see this.
Now I'm going to try to forget about that old trunk and continue outside!
What's that noise coming from the old side entrance?!
It sounds like someone is inside our mansion!
I'd better go and investigate.
Oh my! Who are you, and what are you doing in my house?
Your house? I don't know who you are, young lady, but this is most certainly not your house.
This house belongs to the noble Boulton family.

No. We'd need to take more than just this to the police. You'll need hard evidence to prove Ursula's innocence.
Then I know just what I have to do. I need to finally get inside the mansion!
Grandma, I have to get inside the mansion. Do you have the key?
Oh, Maddie. I knew this day would come, but I can't help you. There's no way to get in.
What?! Why not?

If you try to get in without putting in the correct code, it'll activate the traps and barriers will seal the house up.
Well, what's the code?
I... I don't remember! Truly, Maddie. I forgot it many, many years ago.
You should forget about it too, dearie. Let's just get back to gardening.
I really want to figure out all there is about the corpse flower and who used to plant them here, but now is not the time.
I need to get inside the Mansion in order to prove Grandma's innocence. And that means I can't stay here nurturing some stinking plant.
But what if it dies when I'm away?
I know! I better paint a picture of it so I'll remember what it looked like - just in case.
I feel just like Charlie making sketches and notes. Haha! I guess the apple doesn't fall far from the tree after all.
Wow! Everything looks wonderful! I'm no horticulturist, but safe to say I did a good job restoring the place.
Look at all these pretty flowers! No wonder Charlie liked it here so much. I think it's so sweet that he planted all these Boulton Lilies for Grandma.
And the scent of them almost overpowers the stink of the corpse flower. Yuck!
I still can't believe I managed to grow one... Just like my - well, someone else in the family.
One day I'll get the bottom of this. Meanwhile, I don't think I'll need the seedling kit for now.
I'll hide it somewhere here so I can use it later!
There just has to be a way to get into the mansion without setting off the traps!
Winston obviously knows how to get in - but I don't know where he went!
I wonder if there are any more clues in Grandpa's notebook?
Hmm. There's nothing much, but there is a little sketch of the Cemetery after the Conservatory.
I'm going to go there next and see what I can find out!
I will get into the house, and prove Grandma's innocence once and for all!
Wow! I had no idea there was a whole tennis court here.
I've always wanted to play tennis. Do you know the rules?
Me? Nope. Sorry, dearie. I, uh, I never liked the game.
That's alright! I'm just excited to have found a place like this.
Talking about finding things - have you stumbled upon the family treasure yet?
What treasure? I've never heard of such a thing!
Well, I would advise you to look inside this tennis bag.
You'll find everything you need to work your way into another family secret!
Why is everyone talking in riddles and no one's telling me the truth!
Hi Julius! What brings you round?
Hi, Julius! What brings you round?
In truth, I was taking a little tour of the grounds. I didn't expect anyone to be up here.
I thought that this area of the estate was well and truly closed.
Were you about to play a game?
I... well, I don't know how to play! Grandma never taught me. She says she doesn't like tennis.
Hey, look down there! I think there's a photo sticking out of the bush.
I don't believe it - this is Grandma and her sister Deb! And they're playing tennis! Why would she lie about hating it?
I, ahem, have no idea! Goodness, is that the time? I must dash...
Hmmm, that was strange! Grandma lied about tennis, and Julius ran away. I'm going to call Deb and find out more!
Great Aunt Deb! It's so good to see you. Thanks for coming over.
My pleasure. To be honest, I leapt at the chance - especially since Ursula hardly ever invites me round.
And I can see why she didn't want me to come here. Ha!
It's the scene of the crime, after all...
Crime?! What crime?
She didn't tell you, huh? Well, let's just say that your Grandma was a sore loser when it came to tennis!
Tell me, Maddie - what do you know about the family treasure?
Uh, nothing, but I'm all ears.
Well, I don't want to say too much, but I'm sure it's here. You should look for it - see if you can find my missing treasure!
Grandma! And Great Aunt Deb! I didn't expect to see both of you.
I heard that she came poking around, and decided that I should be here next time she visited!
You're just worried that I'll spill all your secrets! Like how you always used to lose at tennis...
That's a lie! Charlie and I always won. It was you and Julius that lost.
Wait, you used to play doubles with Grandpa and Julius?!
We sure did - and boy, was your Grandpa Charlie cute!
He was cute - and he was mine!
I don't get it. Why did you stop playing? And what does tennis have to do with treasure?

Hmmm. Alright - find the family treasure, Maddie, and you'll see the game of the century.
How can I say no to that?

That's the treasure, alright! But what does that note say?
It says "Ursula and Deb - burying this seems like the only way to stop you fighting over it..."
The last time you played, Julius and I thought you were going to kill each other! Since you never agree who won, I thought everyone should lose this. Charlie.
My Charlie wrote that? Oh, no.

We sure did. Maybe we shouldn't have that rematch. How about a game of checkers and some cake instead?
Deal!
This might not be the sort of treasure I was imagining, but it was fun to find.
I think I'd better bury this again though - it sounds like it was trouble!
But now to the Lighthouse! Since no-one is helping me to find it I'll just go to the shore and look for it myself!
What a cute little part of the estate!
I wonder if it has any clues about what happened between Grandma and Grandpa?
I'm going to ask Grandma to come here and help me out as I tidy up!
Grandma, do you see this?! It says 'Becky loves Mikey' on it!

Well, here you go. This is the place my Michael first saw Becky!
My parents first met by some flowers?
That's right. Becky and her family were new in town, and I invited them here one afternoon.
When little Mikey saw Becky, that was it! He was eight years old, and it was love at first sight.

It would be years and years until she felt the same way as him.
Tell me more!
Don't tell me someone used to drive this old thing? It's a wreck!

Your Grandpa Charlie wasn't happy. He thought something bad would happen in the car.
It turned out he should have worried about something else with those two.
What? Grandma, whatever did happen to my parents?
This is why I don't like telling you family stories! I don't want to dredge up bad things from the past.

This treehouse is just adorable. I can't wait to sit up there and read a book.

Michael left Becky a note here that started his treasure hunt, and led to her finding the engagement ring!
How lovely. It's nice to hear how happy they were!
They were happy... most of the time...

What?! My Mom and Dad broke up? When?
Oh, long before you were born, don't worry! But it was a sad time.

I can't believe this! Why did she do it?

What made them get back together?
Well, Grandma? What made my mom and dad get back together?

What do you mean?

She transferred to a local college, and they got right back on track.
That sounds so sweet! I wish I remembered them.
They were sweet on each other, but they were both even sweeter on you, dearie.
Thanks for asking me to come and help out here, Maddie.
It was nice to be reminded of all the good times with your parents.
I'm glad! Now that we've talked about the good times, can we talk about... the bad times?
What, uh, what exactly happened to my parents?
I really want to know, Grandma.
And I really don't want to talk about it, dearie!

Ruff!!
I can see you like the idea! Let's build you a nice big playground.
Ruff!! Ruff!!
I definitely need a new tool to help me out here!
A table saw will be perfect for the job.
Ahh, yes. This is a cutting edge invention!
I'm not sure if you can read but look over here Rufus! I set up a sign with your name on it!
Ruff!
I know, right? Nice touch, don't you think little buddy. Now everyone can see who's the real boss here.
Ruff Ruff!! Ruff!!
The place looks great. Now you can keep yourself busy playing here.
Ruff!
The only thing I still need to do is give the table saw back.

Ruff!

Rufus, when I was a little girl I used to think I could speak dog!

Ruff?
I guess you said.... ruff!
And I guess I can't speak dog at all.
I wonder why Grandpa drew a spooky old cemetery?
And I wonder why I never noticed this place before!

Really? Did he enjoy coming here?

Hi Roddy! Sorry you caught me in the cemetery.

Aarrrgg! In order to find the Lighthouse I now need to find Grandma and before that a Tennis court?? Great.

Hello? Helloooo? Is anyone there?
Moro! And you are?

Maddie? I'm not your grandfather, I'm Heikki! But we should lift the cat onto the table together.

So, you thought I was Charlie, did you? The brave will eat the soup.

Ahaha! I do talk to the magpies that live around here.

About the birds…
About the birds...
Yes! My wonderful little friends!
I didn't know magpies were local to this area.

These aren't any old magpies you know... They're Finnish Magpies!
What?!
Hope wildlife services don't find out…
Hope wildlife services don't find out...

More like amazing thieves…
More like amazing thieves...
One's own home is worth gold!

Hmmm. Maybe if I fix up the old nest...
Moro!

My little friends had to relocate to the chimney and now I can't heat up my sauna anymore...

Yeah, Charlie had it made for us and our book club!
I guess the wizard is you then?
Maybe.
I wonder why Grandpa isn't up there?

With eggs?

He did. But that was many years later...
Will you tell me how Grandpa saved you now?
Not yet! That is the sugar at the bottom.
I am saving it for last. You are as impatient as Ursula.

I can't believe Charlie threw his spoon in the corner! He should not be dead.

No. But thinking of that old mansion is like thinking of the snow of last winter.

Well, he did make me memorize a riddle once.
A riddle? Could it be another clue?
How did the riddle go? The one Granpa Charlie made you memorize?
How did the riddle go? The one Grandpa Charlie made you memorize?

“Seldom noticed, often seen,

"I am first to greet you to the chateaux,

"Just as secrets lie beneath the sea,

WHAT?!

I got to go.

Moro!

I didn't even know there was a mansion, until I accidently saw Grandma's notice...

Huh?! Who are you?!

Ignatius and Agatha Boulton...

Well... I guess so, but why woul-

Me!

What a struggle! She gave me quite a fight!
She?
Female Blue Marlins are sometimes four times larger than males!
And this one is HUGE!
You must be doing something right to win that!
Thank you, Grandma, but I think this one should go to you!
How come, dearie?
It's for the best photograph!
That's impressive. What's it for?
Most prolific fisher! We caught a lot of fish, after all.
I don't quite believe it...
I won the Master Fisher trophy!
Congratulations, dearie! You really deserve it!
How heavy did you say that fish was?!
How come?
Well, according to the fish guide, you just beat the world record!
Ugh... This thing is heavy! Wait, a minute! Is this a suitcase?!
OH! Well, it looks like a piece of old junk. You should throw it in the trash when we get back.
Does that look like C.B. to you?
I think we should pick the lock!
I doubt there's anything of worth in there...
Don't be like that! Maybe this has something important inside!
Aaw... Just a bunch of soggy paper...
Hmm, there's some writing on them, but they're falling apart, fast!
Old wet paper tends to do that, dearie!
Grandma! I think I've pieced together what looks like a...
A message! Or a riddle? Huh? What does this even mean?!
From the depths, secrets gleam unseen, thus from porcelain's embrace, you'll will find treasures previously unseen.
See? Nonsense! I wouldn't even bother asking around about it...
Welcome everyone to the Great Bush Bonanza! Hopewell Bay’s premier topiary event!
We’re hoping to see some really wonderful creations!
Oooh! A topiary event!
... What’s a topiary?
Sweetie, why it’s the age old tradition of shaping and trimming shrubs into wonderful pieces of art!
Really?! I’m great at that! I’ve had A LOT practice on the Mansion grounds.
Really?! I’m great at that! I’ve had A LOT of practice on the Mansion grounds.
Sweetie, it takes years of practice to become a topiary artist!
Doesn’t seem that hard to me.
Oh really? How about a friendly competition then?
You and Grandma really have a competitive streak, but alright.
You’re on!
That’s the spirit!
While I’m calling it luck, you beat me fair and square!
Well done!
Thank you Deb. I didn’t know how much fun it could be.
Seems like that competitive blood flows in your veins too, Maddie.
I guess so! I am a Boulton after all; you know!
This’ll definitely help me grow some amazing shrubs!
I might use this to grow some lovely tomatoes for my pies too!
Sic parvis magna...
“Greatness from small beginnings.”
A simple box won’t be enough to beat me, sweetie!
I’m sure that will make a fine Christmas shrub!
Alright, looks like I may have some competition after all!
I... Uh... Wow!
How did you...? That’s not possible!
Maddie, sweetie! So good of you to join me in this little endeavor.
It’s no problem aunt Deb, anything to help!
That’s wonderful, because something amazing is about to happen!
Oh?
Yes, my Titan Arum is blooming!
Er... What?
My corpse flower! She’s blooming! Hasn’t done that in 10 years! We need to show the WORLD!
CORPSE FLOWER?!
I admit, it is quite beautiful.
That it is Maddie, sweetie. They can grow tall and strong and live very long lives...
The name “corpse flower” does unfortunately betray many of its beautiful qualities.
Never let a name betray who you really are, Maddie.
Names are just labels we give each other. They don’t define us...
Even if we sometimes wish they did.
I wonder what she meant by that? Doesn’t she like her name?
Ah, Maddie! Right on time! I’ve taken it upon myself to get a little assistance for you!
Er... I’m okay! I don’t think Hank needs to help on this one.
Don’t be silly, sweetie! He’s busy working on a piece of art.
Let me guess... himself?
And what a fine piece of art he is...
Deb?
Oh! I got lost in my thoughts! No, I called that handsome marine biologist of yours, Enrique!
E- Emilio?! He isn’t mine!
Hi Emilio! I’m sorry that Deb dragged you into this.
Hi, Emilio! I’m sorry that Deb dragged you into this.
Don’t worry about it, Maddie. It sounded like she really needed some help.
Wonderful, you’re here! Now, sit down, you two, and I’ll bring you some afternoon tea.
Er- Deb... What are you doing?
Just moving things along, sweetie!
Is... Is everything alright with her?
I’m not sure. She’s been quite manic lately, with the blooming of her corpse flower.
Amorphophallus titanum. How fascinating!
You know plants too?!
No, not me. My mother was a botanist, and she really loved her garden.
Oh... Is she...?
Ah! Sorry, no! She switched careers. She pilots commercial airlines now!
Fascinating...
Wow!
Boy.... is that... fragrant!
A small price to pay for its beauty, sweetie!
Oh Deb, I don’t know if I can have that thing stinking up my home.
It took over a month to get the smell out when we stashed your IMPROVED hopeberry juice!
Rolled out the red carpet, huh?
Well, it is a big occasion after all!
No offense, Deb, but it’s just a flower.
Maddie, sweetie. It’s more than just a flower! That flower is something I’ve cultivated for a very long time...
For me, it shows that there is beauty in everything. Even in the most unlikely places.
Besides, doesn’t hurt to make this place look a bit fancy!
Fleur-de-lis, spikes... I’m sensing a theme here!
You got me! I ADORE European nobility and their architecture. I spent most of my twenties traveling through Europe, looking for...
Looking for what?
... What’s that? Oh, LOVE of course!
Of course.
Well... That’s it. Guess we have to wait another 10 years for the next one.
But good things come to those who wait, right?
If I were you, sweetie... I wouldn’t be waiting too long, though.
Wh- What do you mean by that?
The Titan Arum may only bloom every 10 years, but when it does, it’s only for a few precious days.
It doesn’t dwell on the past and wait for a better time. It takes those rare days and makes them hers!
Huh... Carpe diem?
Precisely, sweetie. Precisely.
Welcome everyone to the Great Pumpkin Palooza! Hopewell Bay’s spooky jack o’lantern event!
It’s time to get creative and see what types of ghoulish masterpieces you can create!
Pumpkin carving? Ha, haven’t done that in ages! Hopewell Bay sure does like keeping to traditions.
Definitely! And it’s a fun way to have a bit of friendly sport. Want to join in?
I- I don’t know... Last time I carved a pumpkin was with my mother... When I was seven.
PERFECT! Here, grab a knife and start carving!
May the best jack o’lantern win!
Wonderful! Let’s get this spooky Palooza started!
That was fun! Amy is going to love these!
I thought you said the last time you carved a pumpkin was when you were seven?!
It’s true, but I do ice sculpting as a pastime.
Geeze... What don’t you do?
Don’t worry about it, buddy! I’m sure you’ll win next time.
Gosh... Thanks.
Nothing like growing fresh produce!
Especially pumpkins! They’re so versatile.
Pumpkin flowers are quite beautiful! I guess I just like the color.
Then, this one is yours...
Oh!
Not too bad, Emilio!
Roddy, your imagination knows no bounds!
I see... Upping the game, are we?
Wow! That’s amazing!
Hold on... You made the wheels move? Wait! Is that music coming from inside?!!
Hello, can I help you?
No, my child... It is I who has come to help... YOU!
Oh... Kay...
Maddie, dearie! I see you have met my old friend, Lady Voyance.
She’s a psychic, you know!
Really? How interesting! Came here to give Grandma a reading?
For heaven’s sake, no! I have come to help all of Hopewell Bay! I sense a great change in the future!
Ursula has graciously let me set up my services temporarily, so that I may help everyone in need.
... Especially you, Maddie. I can sense that something amazing is in store for you.
Really?!
Yes, my child! Love is in the air!
Wait... You read people’s fortunes from...
A SNOW GLOBE?!
Yes, my child! The snowflakes react to the strands of fate that bind us all...
And so, I read the unique patterns of their fall.
But... It’s a snow globe!
Hello, my child! Come to have your fortune told?
My fortune? No, I just came over to ask if Ma-
Shh! Let me consult the snow! You are here to see... Maddie!
Yes... She here?
No, my child, your paths do not cross at this time...
I’m not a child. My name is-
Shh! I sense your name is... Jackie!
Incredible... Exactly what is written on my press badge.
Ah... A skeptic.
A reporter.
I sense GREEEAT conflict in your future!
Hi... I’m uuuh, here to see the psychic?
Yes, my child... I knew you would come.
Y- You did?!
Of course! The globe never lies... And for you, I see wonderful things ahead!
Finally!
I sense that you’ve been waiting for a looong time too!
I... I have!
Do not worry, my child... Your wait is almost over.
Oh wow!
Ah, Maddie! Please, step inside.
Hello, Lady Voyance! I guess I’m ready for my reading now.
I know, my child... Let us begin....
I see a great loss in your life. Oh, poor thing, you’ve lost so much! But yet...
Despite it all, you’ve gained a lot more in return. Perhaps even things you do not yet know you have!
What does that mean?
Shh! The globe still SPEAKS to me! I see that you are searching for... Something.
Actually, I’m looking for something to help Gran-
Love!
Love?!
Yes! And your search is almost over, for love has found.... YOU!
What?! Who?!
I... I’m sorry. The globe has gone silent. But it is close, my child. CLOSE.
Hey! Is-
Shhh! You are here to ask me a question!
Y- Yes! How did you know that?!
Shhh! The GLOBE SPEAKS!
You also like to work out!
Whoah.... This is getting freaky! What are you?
I am a medium...
Awesome! I’m... XXL myself!
Lady Voyance... I see that you’ve moved your shady operation to this ramshackle hole...
How fitting!
Regardless, you STILL need a business license to perform your little show.
I am performing my services for free.
Not a good business model if you ask me...
Heed my words Victoria... I see GREEEEAT DAAAANGER in your future!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
It is quite entertaining. I’ll give you that!
That Lady Voyance sure is a character!
Yes, she is, dearie. Did she give you a reading?
Yes! She said I was about to find love! Or it... Me? I couldn’t quite understand what she meant.
Yes, she can be very confusing sometimes. I guess it has something to do with her 20% accuracy rate.
Yes, but in that 20%, she’s right all the time.
I don’t think that’s how it works, Grandma.
Shh... Don’t tell her that!
Hmm... I wonder why this spot is known as a side entrance?
Well, dearie, the house help used this as their entrance to the mansion.
Grandma! You frightened me!
Maddie, dearie, I've told you many a time to keep your wits about you.
This grand old oak tree must have been such a beauty back in the day...
I can imagine it being a popular meeting point!
It'll need lots of tender loving care and hydration to return to its original state.
Hold on, are those... envelopes in the trunk?
They are envelopes! Looks like they've been here a long time...
Judging by the heart, it's definitely a love letter. Ooh, this is so exciting!
Let's see here. Hmm, the ink is a bit faded...
"At first I was worried about our differences. We come from very different worlds, as you know, but you were right."
"True love defies everything. The first time we met under this very oak tree, all my doubts disappeared."
Oh, my! Who are these mystery lovebirds?!
Another letter! The handwriting looks different...
"My dear Lionheart, I couldn't take my eyes off of you at the dance tonight."
"It was almost like you were the only person in the room and everyone else was invisible"
"I know we can't be seen together so find me when the party is over. I'll be waiting for you."
Wow! These letters are beautiful! It looks like this oak tree holds a lot of love and some secrets too.
It sounds like a forbidden romance, though. These letters must be between two servants from the mansion!
Hi, Maddie! What are you up to?
Roddy, you won't believe it! I was fixing up this place when I found love letters hidden in the old oak tree!
These letters are so swoon-worthy! Listen to this...
"Every day without you is torture, my Lionheart. I so wish that we could walk hand-in-hand for all to see."
Wow! That's intense.
Say, Maddie, do you like love letters? I mean, if um, someone were to write you one?
Of course! Expressing yourself like that is a lost art form these days...
Really? Oh um, I just remembered I have something to do. I'll catch up with you later!
That was odd...
I found a letter that was stuck to the previous one! It seems sadder than the others. Words have been scratched out...
"Things are getting tougher. I feel like I'm constantly being watched."
"There are questions surrounding my operation and the legitimacy of the money."
"We might have to leave sooner than expected."
"I can't wait for our new life together, my darling Winnie."
Winnie? Hmm, whoever could that be?
Wow, it's an old suitcase! It's got some shoes and clothes...
And a whole bunch of silver that looks like it came from the mansion. Probably stolen.
There's a stack of love letters as well!
The last love letter I read mentioned that these lovebirds were planning to run away...
This has to be what they were going to use to start their new life elsewhere!
It seems like they were ready to leave. Why didn't they?
Reading those love letters made me feel like I was right there with them.
What they went through sounds pretty distressing.
I wish I could know that everything worked out but the fact that the suitcase is here says otherwise.
True, I'm quite curious about this shady operation, though...
I wonder if it was happening on mansion grounds.
I have a feeling that the butler would know. He's been around for ages!
The butler? It looks like I have more discoveries to make! Hey, what's this?
Oh, you must have missed a letter...
"Roses are red, violets are blue. I don't really like poems, but I do like you"
Ahem, Roddy? Did you write this?
Nuh-uh, I believe you have a secret admirer!
Haha, that's one secret I guess I can live with!
Oh, no! I think Rufus has been digging the ground again.
Wait a second, there's something buried here. That's probably why!
Untangling that swing was quite a feat! Now I can finally try it out!
I have to admit, swings always bring out my inner child.
Ooh, there are some initials carved into the wood. V? No, W and the other one is... too defaced for me to recognize.
Darn it. Well, at least I have one initial to work with...
Hmm... This tree still doesn't look too good. It definitely needs a lot of water to spring back!
Where would I be able to find that much water...
Oh, I have an idea! The old well!
Looks like there's plenty of water here to fix that poor tree but there's only so much I can carry at a time.
Let me fill up this bucket and I'll come back for more!
Look at this! It's a producer booster!
This nifty booster removes all cooldowns from producers next to it for a limited time.
Maddie, I have a bit of a favor to ask you.
What kind of favor?
Well, see, the thing is... I might have booked another job at the same time as yours.
Really?! Another plumbing job?
Umm... more like some garden work for my aunt.
I noticed you have a bunch of cool gardening equipment here. Mind helping me out?
Alright. But, only because you're injured!
You're the best! I guarantee that it'll be worth it!
What do you need wax for?
Oh, it's for my aunt's um... garden shed?
Oh right, makes sense!
A tape measure? Are you installing something?
Y-yes?
My aunt needs a grand display for her garden!
Oh, sounds nice!
Hmm, I might as well start fixing a few things here before Ash returns!
It shouldn't be too hard, right? I've got this!
Thanks for all the hard work, Maddie!
I'm sure you- I mean my aunt will appreciate it!
Sure thing! There were some strange requests though...
Hey, Maddie! Is everything OK with Grandma Ursula?
There are so many ways to answer that... Why do you ask?
Erm, there are a bunch of big motorcycles outside her house! But they look oddly... cozy and sweet.
Hmm... I know she loves her bike, but that sounds pretty wild, even for her!
I think we need to find out what's going on. Let's just sneak a little bit closer and take a look...
Look at that! Grandma's house is full of old ladies having tea - in full biker gear!
Grannies of Anarchy... I've heard rumblings about this gang. I should have guessed your Grandma is involved somehow!
Grandma's in a BIKER GANG? What is she - Easy Rider?! What are they whispering about, anyway?
Eavesdropping on your own Grandma, Maddie? I'm so here for it.
Uh-oh... Did you hear that? I'm pretty sure one of them just said something about... a MURDER!
Did you just hear those ladies whisper something about a murder?
They are a biker gang, but murder? Then again, those knitting needles look pretty sharp...
What are they doing - drawing up a biker granny hit list?
I think we need to dig a little deeper. Come on, Jackie. Let's see what these biking buddies are up to!
Maddie, what on earth are you doing sneaking around?
Err... We were just admiring these impressive motorbikes on your drive.
I didn't know you were expecting guests, Grandma!
There's plenty you don't know, dearie...
These are my friends. We are all members of a little hobby group.
That's quite the hobby group...
Well, we all enjoy a good kicker with some farkle, but a citizen like you would probably not understand such things.
What language was that?
That was biker slang. This is our biker gang, the Grannies of Anarchy.
Ha! So I was right!
Tell us more, Grandma! When did you join your biker gang?
Oh, we've been flying our colors for decades.
The world was different when we founded the club, and we yearned for the freedom of the open road...
So, we decided to put together a group of like-minded ladies to challenge the more... traditional views.
What an amazing story, Ursula. An all-female biker gang is a totally rebellious idea.
And the knitted decorations on your bikes are really amazing!
We do know a thing or two about knitting... and rebellion.
When we started our motorcycle club, people just did not take us seriously.
So, we were forced to break the rules every now and again.
We did ruffle some feathers, too.
Your biker club looks like a wild bunch! But what exactly do you do?
Burn rubber and stand up against the man, of course!
Oh? So things sometimes get out of hand?
Whatever do you mean?
Does your gang dabble with anything... criminal?
Why on earth do you think our club would be involved in criminal activity?
We happened to overhear some of your conversation and... it sounded  fishy.
You were eavesdropping? That is rather rude, dearie.
I admit that our crochet work is so good that it's criminal, but we are certainly no outlaws!
What kind of crimes did you have in mind?
Murder?
Murder?? You should get your ears checked, dearie.
Oh, now I understand. My friend Mama said that we need a new recorder. You must have misheard her!
I guess that could've been it, but...
That's settled then!
What a relief! They're just a group of nice old ladies.
Who happen to ride around on big bikes and wear leather jackets!
Your Grandma is full of surprises!
She certainly is...
So, you don't think they are really involved in anything shady?
I guess not. But what would a biker gang need a recorder for?
It's time for us to get our domes on and grab a handful.
That means that we are going take off for a drive, dearie.
I gathered that, Grandma. You and your friends are quite an impressive bunch!
Thank you! You can forget about any crimes. The Grannies of Anarchy always ride on the right side of the law.
I still feel like you're not telling me everything. There's more to your skillfully knitted patches than you let on...
Some of us were just born to be wild, Maddie, dearest.
Trim the sails and batten down the hatches because adventure awaits!
Whoa! What an adorable little pirate ship!
Erm... I built it myself. The wood is from the shed and the flag is my mom's tablecloth! I mean... Never mind!
I've built a boat or two. Maybe I can help you spruce up your vessel?
Oh, that would be so cool! Can we have a BIG anchor?
AND golden trims on the railings? AND a mysterious monkey cave??
What's up? Are you two planning a pirate adventure?
Maddie! Emilio is helping me build the BIGGEST and BESTEST pirate ship in the WORLD!
Hello, Maddie! Well, maybe not the biggest in the world...
You know, I read somewhere that there were pirates on Hopewell Bay a looong time ago...
R-real pirates? In Hopewell Bay??
Hmm... I'm sure I saw something in the attic. Old papers and stuff...
Ooooh, I hear adventure calling!
Are you SURE you know what you're doing? There's not a lot of ship left.
We're taking it apart to build it anew!
Whoa, look out! There are some PRRRETTY rusty nails in there.
Mom says you can get sick if you hurt yourself on them!
I think you should always listen to your mother.
Huh! She says that too...
So, young Mason. A good ship needs a strong skeleton.
That'a a great idea! Skeletons are soooo cool.
Can we have skeletons AND a Monkey Cave?
That would be AWESOME!
I'm talking about the frame of the ship. See, now we can start to build!
And then we'll do the skeletons?
What do you think? A handsome ship, isn't it?
Yeah, really handsome! Although... It's missing a mast.
Well, yes... But not too bad, even if I do say so myself.
And you know what would be REALLY rad?
W-what?
Some water for the ship to sail in!
Shiver me timbers! It's starting to look like a pirate ship!
You can say that again! I think we've done pretty well here.
We still need finish the poop deck...
The WHAT?
The poop deck - located at the back of the ship...
It's the... Forget about it. Let's add some color!
Hehehe! Poop deck...
Phew, that was quite a job!
Aye, Emilio. T'was!
But without wind in its sails, my ship is going nowhere fast.
Yes, sails...
And there COULD be some cannons... In case I need to protect the ship, you know.
And it needs a pirate flag!
Of course.
There's no mistaking it now.
Pirates sail here, so all landlubbers better beware!
Are you ready for an adventure?
Yes and it will be EPIC! Only...
Don't get me wrong. I love it! Its better than I ever could have imagined, but...
Don't tell me.
... there's no Monkey Cave.
It's PERFECT!
The ship, the cannons, the lake, the MONKEY CAVE!
Yes, it's more than I had planned for, but...
It really is glorious. And there's some very interesting sealife in there, too. Did you notice... Maddie!
Ohoy! I can't believe you've built all this!
Well, Emilio did help a little.
Well, adventure calls! See you later, you scallywags!
Safe travels, young Mason!
HARRR! That's Captain Mason, if you don't mind.
I bet the Boulton attic is super old and dusty. Which means that it's FULL of cool old stuff...
Like treasure maps!!
I have my quest.
It may be perilous, filled with unknown dangers and impossible obstacles...
But Captain Mason never says no to adventure!
Where should I begin? The place is full of old junk!
Maddie mentioned old papers... Could there be a map, too?
Mysterious boxes! And dusty old furniture, straight from a pirate ship!
We just keep Christmas decorations in our attic... This is WAY better!
Oh, WOW! What's going on here?
This old chest has to be filled with treasure!
Dagnabbit - it's locked! And no sign of a key...
I bet if I keep digging, I'll find some clues.
Blistering barnacles! This desk is FULL of stuff!
Parchment, sailor thingies... and COINS!
But these aren't pirate coins - just dusty old money. And no key...
What's this? An old letter written by some old seadog? A pirate called Boulton?
No WAY! The key is buried in the huge garden! Oh, how can I find it THERE??
The metal detector! I think I saw one in the garage...
Extra powerful batteries to find a buried key - CHECK!
Now I just need to put these in the metal detector, and we're in business.
This key is reeeeally old, but this thing will find it!
But if there's a treasure, there could be treasure hunters! I better be fast.
HARRR! The metal detector is ready to go!
Sink me - it has no BATTERIES!
Where can I find THOSE??
There's a lot of junk in the attic... I bet I can find some batteries up there, too!
Hmm... What DOES a sailor need?
Some rope. And a compass!
Do I know how to use a compass? Maybe I should pack the GPS, too.
I'll just grab the whole box. Don't want to get stranded at sea!
I wish I had some pirate clothes.
A-HA! The costume store! I hope they have eye patches...
Now I just need the right get-up.
The stuff every decent pirate needs...
A hook... and an EYE PATCH!
And a sword to fight any busted buccaneers!
I did it! I finally found the MAP!!
This is it - my final quest!
There's no knowing what I'll come up against. Stormy seas, treacherous traps... a rumbling belly!
I'll pack some snacks just in case.
Hmmmm... The lighthouse is in the wrong place on the map.
It looks like the Hopewell Bay lighthouse, but ISN'T!
I need to follow these clues, cause the treasure waits for no man.
Could there be ANOTHER lighthouse?
The map tells me to out to sea... But HOW?
The rowing boat by the pier! I hope it's not booby-trapped...
Quick - there's no time to waste!
I see something on the horizon... A desert island!!
This is where I'd hide a treasure...
There's EVEN a dark, scary cave!
The pirates got caught in a storm... and shipwrecked here!
The crew was saved, but the treasure...
It must still be here!
So the stories of pirates in the Boulton family are true...
And I found their ULTIMATE pirate treasure!!
I'm... RICH!
Thus ends the epic adventure of Captain Mason, the terror of the Seven Seas.
I found the KEY!!
Now I can open the mysterious chest and get my hands on the treasure!
Jackpot! Is this the treasure I'm looking for?
This old coffer is full of pirate booty, but I think there's an even bigger treasure somewhere...
I knew that old pirate captain had something up his sleeve.
This is just a taste of the REAL treasure!
Now I need to follow the clues to find it...
A red coat, a gold chain and a big hat... NOW we're talking!
Who would dare to cross Captain Mason?
Another little coin...
So there is a treasure SOMEWHERE!
What a dusty coin! It looks really old and kinda valuable...
Nah! I think I'll keep looking for something better!
Oooh, my pirate senses are tingling!
Now where would a pirate hide the rest of his booty?
A real gold DOUBLOON!
It's straight from a pirate's coffer... But there has to be more!
One, two, three, four... and these look like gold!
I think I'm getting closer!
To sail the Seven Seas and plunder for riches...
This is a whole BAG of gold doubloons!
More treasure from the briny deep!
This coin has a 'B' stamped on it. Does that stand for... Boulton??
Blow me down! A whole chest full of gold!
And the chest has the same 'B' as the doubloons...
So there were pirates in the Boulton family!

It only gets better!
Today, a curious letter arrived, accompanied by an old key.
It spoke of a legendary sunken treasure and a crown jewel, with eerie and peculiar properties.
From its description, I theorize it may in fact be a piece of Boultonite! Could it be true?
The key that came with the letter led me to the archives where it unlocked an old dusty chest.
Filled with dusty records, the chest contained clues that will hopefully lead me to the treasure’s location.
I should take time to study these clues, if I’m to seek this treasure.
I’ve spent many nights poring over the various documents and old maps the chest contained.
But I believe I have finally discovered the location of the last known location of the sunken ship!
A chain of uncharted islands off the coast may hold the fortune that I am seeking!
Preparations are underway!
I’ve chartered a power steam ship and assembled a capable crew.
The promise of fortune and discovery fills their hearts and my own. The adventure is about to begin!
After months at sea, we have finally arrived near an uncharted island!
Its rocky silhouette that looms against the horizon is almost exactly described in the clues I uncovered!
A massive cave entrance beckons us, emanating a ghostly sound, whispering secrets of what lies within.
Incredible! Our exploration of the cavern’s depths has revealed a wrecked ship!
To our astonishment, the ship hadn’t sunk at all but was left derelict within this cave...
But a disturbing question remains... Why?
Exploring the ship has frustratingly not revealed any answers why the ship was hidden here.
Furthermore, the main hold of the ship has flooded, halting our exploration.
We must proceed with our diving equipment if we are to reach the treasure hold!
With diving equipment secured, we descended into the watery depths...
After struggling to remove some rotten wood and debris, we have finally arrived at the main treasure hold.
We must rest now and continue in the morning. After all this time, the treasure is finally within reach!
With excitement, we finally opened the treasure hold, revealing its wonders!
Golden artifacts, ancient trinkets and unbelievable hoards of riches greeted us.
And there, amidst this hoard of a century, I finally saw it!
A Colossal Boultonite jewel, radiant and untouched, a crowning jewel to a lost dynasty.
Now, as I sail home and the jewel gleaming in the sun, I am struck with a thought.
What became of the crew of that ship? And...
What if this jewel had something to do with it?!

We are drawing closer to the ice pack. We were forewarned about the dangers lurking here, but we must forge ahead.
Members of my brave crew are conducting scientific study of the area, which I predict will prove to be very useful indeed - as long as we do not become trapped by the ice...
Yesterday, we reached land. We disembarked, formed two smaller groups and set out with some basic supplies to explore further.
Our tents are woefully weak against the elements here, but our spirits are high. According to my calculations, the meteorite is close!
Alas, we have had to abandon our initial plan. The pack ice is threatening to trap our ship, if the worst happens, we will be confined in this frozen realm for a considerable time.
We are not out of danger, but the safety of the crew must come first.

Tools of the trade, looks like...always good to have a place to put your stuff.
Looks like a vintage coffee infuser on the top shelf there - I wonder if it still works?
And I love these scales. So much more tactile than the digital ones!
But wait...is that a butter churner...?
Hello again...Ratthew? Ratthew sounds right.
If Victoria saw you now she'd blow a gasket. But I think you're rather cute, actually.
Glad you're getting some use out of this butterchurner, Ratthew.
Glad you're getting some use out of this butter churner, Ratthew.
Now, perhaps it's time for you to...wait, where did you go?
Is that something under the carpet?
So it's true! The pantry is back up and running again!
Oh, Cherry! You found your way here! Welcome! Uh - what's all this?
Fresh fruit, just like my mama used to bring!
We do need to restock! Did you see the kitchen?
I did! I think you missed a spot when cleaning.
Some red jam on the floor over by the knives - no big deal!
Oh...ugh...long story...
Okay! Can you help me set up?
Sure, Cherry.
So, Cherry, I found these old recipe cards when I was cleaning.
Vintage recipe cards? My, oh my, let me take a look at those!
Sure - here you go. I was thinking...
Maddie! Do you know what this is?
Uhh...a recipe for Hopeberry jam, I think?
Not just any recipe for Hopeberry jam! This is THE recipe for Hopeberry jam!
I...what? What does that mean?!
I'll tell you after we try to make it!
Mmmm! Delicious! Absolutely delicious!
It is! So what did you mean with 'the' recipe?
Huh? Oh, nevermind that. This isn't it!
What do you mean?
Everyone knows there's a secret Hopewell Bay Hopeberry Jam recipe. I thought this was it, but...nope!
You mean Grandma's recipe? I'm pretty sure these are older than her.
Exactly! No, I've only tasted it in jam from old jars with a special butterfly logo on them!
I see...
Anyway, let's continue restocking these shelves!
Looks like we've got everything back to its old glory, more or less!
You know my mother used to come here every week with fresh produce for the kitchen.
Of course that all stopped when they shut it all down.
So I'm glad I can pick up the tradition again!
I mean - I don't know if we're going to need to fire up the WHOLE kitchen again...
It's quite a lot for just Grandma and me...
We can use it! With all the events, parties and gatherings you've hosted here since you started renovations...
...no dust will gather in this kitchen again! I promise you that!
Aww. That'd be nice. Speaking of dust...
We better clean up a little, yes!
So, Cherry, before you go - I found this jar when I was cleaning.
Is that...that's the logo! The butterfly logo!
Actually, that's a double B-logo. Boulton and....Blackwood.
Blackwood? What have they got to do with this?
It looks like my great-grandmother Agatha was friends with Christine Blackwood.
It looks like my great-grandmother, Agatha, was friends with Christine Blackwood.
They developed the recipe for this jam together.
Well, isn't that surprising! Did you find the recipe too?
Uhh, maybe. I have a lot of old recipe cards here! One of them is probably it!
I wish I could stay and try a few more...but maybe later!
Sure, Cherry! Thanks for all the help!
Happy Halloween Grandma! Are those the decorations I was looking for?
Happy Halloween, dearie. Oh no, this is just something I found in the Boulton family archives!
I thought perhaps you'd want them for the charity shop?
You think so? They look pretty special. Like...spell books!
Oh, I suppose they do! We Boulton women have been known to dabble.
Dabble? In...magic? Don't be silly, Grandma. I don't believe in that kind of stuff!
Of course not, dearie. But do you mind if I leave them with you, in case you change your mind?
Sure, Grandma. At least they fit the decor!
Annnnd another pumpkin carved! Phew. This is starting to look very nice!
I can't stop thinking about Grandma's spell books though. Maybe...
...can't hurt to take a look. 'tis the season after all.
Hah. How appropriate. A potion for sharpening knives!
And I've already got all the ingredients here. Hmm...
Hello, dearie! Oh, what a lovely little corner you've made!
Not now, Grandma. I'm looking for pokeweed.
Oh, dear, that's quite poisonous, you know. What is it for?
For a spell, of course! For finding things. Aha! Here's one, let me just cut it...
My, that's a very sharp-looking knife you got there. Tell me, what's lost?
If I told you that, it would spoil the experiment!
Right! This is of course still all nonsense, but...
...but what, dearie?
Well, there have been an awful lot of coincidences. Knives sharpening themselves, lost objects found...
What was it you had lost?
Some halloween decorations from last year. I finished the spell, spoke the words, and...poof! There they were.
Oh, my. Perhaps you really are a witch.  Wouldn't be the first Boulton!
Hello, dearie! How're the preparations coming for the charity shop?
There's something here...a code. References between the books...a secret!
Maddie? Are you quite all right?
Look: each of these books reference the same spell, and each only contain one part of the ritual!
Oh, Maddie, are you sure you want to dabble in dark magic? Especially at a time like this?
I...I have to know! It says it needs to be cast at midnight...
This will do very well for the charity shop Maddie. Good work!
What? Oh - these aren't for sale, these are all the things needed for the spell!
How curious that the spell knew of all the things around the mansion I was thinking of selling at the shop.
Hm? Oh, yes, luckily everything that was needed for the spell was in the mansion somewhere!
And now you've gathered it all here, nicely organized. And you got the cauldron boiling!
I did. Now all I have to do is cast the spell. I'm a bit nervous, Grandma.
No need to be. I think I might know what will happen when you do...
Aha! The potion is complete! Whoa. Should it be bubbling like that?
What have you made there, dearie?
Oh! Grandma. I made a...potion. Don't laugh, but it's for a spell.
It smells delicious! Let me have a taste.
A...are you sure? Some of the ingredients seemed a little sketchy!
Oh, don't worry, I've trained to recognize poisons. And this...is tasty!
A resounding Halloween success! We sold so much old junk, and made a tidy sum to donate!
And you got to experience what it is like to be a witch.
I actually half-believed finishing that ritual would do something!
It didn't? It made you believe in the supernatural for a moment!
How on earth did you set it all up so perfectly, Grandma?
I will not tell you all my secrets, Maddie. That is where the real magic is.
Good evening, Maddie. Are you ready for the festival?
Evening Julius! No? What festival?
The Lights for the Lost Festival of course!
It is a long-standing tradition in Hopewell Bay, in remembrance of sailors lost at sea.
Oh! In that case: I'm not ready at all! What happens during it?
We fold paper lanterns with lights, and let them float out into the bay when the sun sets.
While telling stories and remembering the lost. Don't forget that, Julius!
O...okay! Then I better get working on those lanterns!
Phew! That wasn't half as hard as I thought it would be.
What a beautiful lantern you've made, Maddie!
Thanks, Julius. Let's hope it floats.
I have no doubt it will. Now we just need a few more.
Define 'a few'.
No need to worry, dear. I will tell you when you can stop folding. Now get back to it!
Okay! I think I've got most of the supplies! Candles, paper, glue...
There is still time before evening, dear.
I know! I just want to make sure I get it right. What if the boats all sink?
All boats sink eventually, Maddie.
Sure, but I'd like to keep them afloat long enough for the ceremony!
...which, by the way, I'm still not sure how it goes..?
Then let me tell you. It is my favorite part!
Where was I? Oh yes - the stories. Usually we start while we fold the boats.
Hopewell Bay has a very strong maritime culture, Maddie.
There is fishing, which you know, of course. But the sea was also important for trade and travel!
But the sea can be dangerous. Not every sailor comes back.
Indeed, yes! All manner of things could befall a sailor out to sea. Storms, pirates, shipwreck.
But at times they were simply late. The winds changed, or they were blown off course.
I guess they didn't have mobile phones to call and check in, huh.
They did not, dear. But looking to the horizon day after day, hoping against hope...that's no way to live.
Joining the Lights for the Lost festival was a way of saying goodbye.
So the people would tell stories about their lost loved ones while making the lanterns.
And then when they let them go, it was...sort of like a funeral at sea.
I can't imagine there are that many sailors lost to sea any longer, though...
We've got...GPS and sea charts and a lot fewer pirates!
Yes. These days, we usually remember anyone we've lost, not just sailors.
Aww. That's actually really sweet.
It's almost time! Does everyone have their lanterns?
Yes, yes. I am coming. To the row boat!
Look - others have already begun to let their lanterns go from the shore.
Indeed. They are catching the ebb tide, making sure the lanterns are carried out to sea.
Let's make sure we catch it too! I want to see it from the water.
This one is for my Dad. Thank you for making me curious.
Michael definitely was curious. He'd take things apart just to see how they work.
It took a little time to teach him he'd still need to put them back together again afterwards!
Your grandpa Charlie was left with more than one disassembled toy to fix...
And this one is for my Mom. For always making me feel safe and loved.
Oh, Maddie. Rebecca was the best mother anyone could hope for.
She would be so proud of the woman you've become.
It's so beautiful with all the lanterns bobbing on the waves.
And none of them have sunk yet!
Thank you, Grandma and Julius. I think I needed this.
I am glad you could finally participate, Maddie.
It is quite the spectacle, even if you do not have anyone you are saying goodbye to.
What do both you say to some mulled wine to warm us up after that boat ride?
What do both of you say to some mulled wine to warm us up after that boat ride?
I have some pictures in the family photo album to show you. And some more funny stories.
That sounds wonderful, Grandma.

LDE_Hopeberry2024_CutsceneDialogue1_Dial.value: I bet she's exhausted from being fixed up on all those bad blind dates.
Seems like she finally struck gold, if you ask me!
Who is that Maddie's on a date with?
