I heard he's a pediatric surgeon.
Apparently, he also runs an animal rescue charity in his free time.
AND he was chosen as the most eligible bachelor of the yea---
Okay, okay, I get it. He's P-PERFECT!
No, not at all! J-just glad for her.
Come on - let's get another glass of hopeberry juice...

LDE_PicnicConfusion2024_IntroCutscene_Di.value: Jackie! Great to see you, what's up?
Just coming over to see how you're doing? You know... after what happened.
Jackie... I'm totally fine! I'm over Emilio. Honest!
Phew. That's good! I thought that photo of him would've really done a number on you.
The one he posted on his social me- Uh oh!
*sigh* No, it's alright. I've also started dating again, so it's okay for him to find someone else...
I mean... look at her! She looks lovely!

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_01.value: It took all night to clean the soot. I didn't expect Grandma's old house to be on fire when I was called here!

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_02.value: Hmm, there's even a gated wall - just how big IS this property? And why was it kept a secret from me?

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_03.value: That gate is locked for a reason, dearie.

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_04.value: Grandma! Where were you?! I can't believe you've been hiding this place-

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_05.value: Calm down, dearie. We can talk about that soon. Don't you want to see our family mansion first?

MMM_Variant_Cutscene_Intro_06.value: Oh, wow! You bet I do!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_BuddyUnlockCutscene_Dia.value: Oh, a text from Cherry. But what-- Is that the same alpaca I saw here earlier??
There's a baby alpaca in my front yard! I named it Buddy. Isn't he adorable?
I don't know what to do! Do you think he could live in my garden shed?
Thank you so much for helping me, Maddie!
That's OK, Cherry! Did you try to call someone? Maybe someone's missing him.
I did! There's no sign of an owner, and the local farms aren't missing him either.
So he just appeared out of the blue in your front yard??
Yeah, with a little bag of apples.
Whatever happened, the whole thing is a real nightmare.
This is my busiest season business-wise, so I don't have time to babysit this cutie...
He can stay here with us. There's always room for an animal this furry!

SP_AlpacaPet2024_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_.value: I love the fall. It's the best season with the leaves turning and all the coziness!
That reminds me, I need to do some raking...
If I start early enough, I might just get it all done.
Where on earth did you come from?
Did you run away from Santa's workshop, or something?
Did you run away from Santa's workshop or something?
Wait, I might have some apples inside...

SP_AmyPet2025_AmyUnlockCutscene_Dialogue.value: Here she is. Amy, do you remember Maddie?
Welcome to the Mansion, Amy! I promise I will make you super comfortable while you're here.
You really are so sweet for doing this. Could we snap a quick photo?
Perfect! I need to get to work but I'll be back to see her, okay?
Ughh, what was that? "See you later, alligator"... Who even says that??
I started to act like a clown as soon as Emilio paid attention to me.
Remember your resolution, Maddie. No men, no drama!

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_01.value: Hello, Maddie! How are you on this beautiful day?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_02.value: Oh, hey! I'm great. And how are you?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_03.value: I'm very well, too. Well, actually there's something weighing on my mind...

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_05.value: Maybe you remember my cat, Amy?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_06.value: I'm not able to keep her until I've found a more permanent place here in Hopewell Bay.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_07.value: Does--- does that mean you're staying here?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_08.value: I guess so... I feel like I owe you an explanation for everything.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_10.value: No. Leaving you for Bolivia, coming here with Bella... I've been unfair and thoughtless.

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_11.value: I'm sorry, Maddie. Maybe we could grab a cup of coffee sometime? Talk things through?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_13.value: Right! I know you're busy but could you maybe take Amy for a while? Just a little while?

SP_AmyPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_14.value: I guess I can do it...

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_IntroCutscene_Di.value: Hmmm, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to offend...
Do you need a new home?
I have just the perfect place!
But I'm getting way ahead of myself.
Let's start this story from the beginning!

SP_MiniHorseMystery2024_ReggieUnlockCuts.value: The wedding preparations are coming along nicely! How are your toes, Deb?
They are toasty warm, thank you! I could not be happier.
I'm happy to hear it! I just heard that we can expect a large delivery soon. Probably stuff for the wedding!
I hope it is my corpse flower arrangements!
Oh, it is a mini horse! We used to breed them with my ex-husband, Count Reginald III of Wallopstone.
He IS handsome, isn't he? There is a letter - with Reginald's seal!
Hmm... He sent me "Little Reginald" as a wedding present. How thoughtful!
A horse needs stables - or in his case, mini stables!
Don't worry, Lil' Reggie. We'll build you a beautiful house!
Deb, can I take a look at that letter? I think you missed a couple of lines...
Sure! I am off to tell Hank about Little Reginald - a new family member. He'll be thrilled!

SP_MysteriesUnveiled2024_IntroCutscene_D.value: Who would do such a thing?
Oh, dearie... Have you read the news?
I thought you and Jackie were friends?
It says here that Ignatius Boulton spied on the people of Hopewell Bay!
And sold those secrets! He... allegedly did this across the country and secretly used the tin can factory to transport them!
... Is this true, Grandma? Is our family responsible?
I... I need some time alone, Grandma.
And do something with all these cans!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_CocoUnlockCut.value: I can't take it! You guys are so CUTE!
How about we give you a name? How about Coco?
You know what? You just gave me a great idea!
Who says we still can't enjoy a relaxing summer? I'm going to build us a spa!

SP_MysteriousMaelstrom2024_IntroCutscene.value: Well... so much for my relaxing week. Let’s see what’s going on...
Oh, dear! Are those all the cans Mason dug up?!
Look what I found! I think the storm brought them here.
Mom said I can’t keep them, so I thought I’d bring them here!
Aaw, aren’t you a long way from home?
Well, don’t you worry! I’ll make sure you feel right at home.

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_01.value: My mom sent me a card and told me that there's a big surprise arriving for me today.

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_03.value: No, my other mom - Charlotte. She works away, so she wanted to send me something special.

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_04.value: I wonder if I'm finally getting that potato cannon!

SP_PigPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue_05.value: Yikes! Let's hope it's something less messy.

SP_PigPet2025_PetUnlockCutscene_Dialogue.value: Do you have any idea what Mason's surprise could be?
I'm not totally sure. Charlotte wouldn't tell me what it is, but I have my suspicions. I just hope I'm not right.
Uh-oh! I think I can see a delivery van.
Mason, I think your surprise is here!
What is it? What is it?
Aaaaawww, a mini pig! Mom writes that she's sorry she couldn't be here but the pig is very cuddly.
Mom, you scared him! Come on, he's such a cute little guy.
You have to admit that he's pretty adorable, Pearl!
I guess he is... But where are we going to put a pig??

SP_RaccoonPet2025_IntroCutscene_Dialogue.value: Have you noticed things going missing recently? I could swear I left my favorite teacup on the porch...
And someone stole a whole bag of potato chips from the kitchen window!
A bunch of stuff the circus sent ahead also disappeared. I've also been hearing some weird noise outside at night.
I was starting to get worried, so I installed a doorbell camera at your front door.
Good thinking, dearie! Let's see what it has recorded.
A raccoon! He must have come here with the circus equipment.
I knew that circus would bring trouble...
Look how cute he is! Poor thing has no home, he has to steal food to get by...
What? I didn't even say anything!

SP_RaccoonPet2025_PetUnlockCutscene_Dial.value: What is that rustling sound? I bet it's that raccoon!
Hello, little guy! Don't be afraid, I'm not going to hurt you.
You're kinda cute, but you need to stop stealing stuff.
Grandma's not too happy about you creeping around. You took her favorite teacup!
Awwww, don't worry - she'll warm up to you, I know it!
What is your story anyway? Maybe the ringmaster knows where you came from.

SP_StrayBonesMystery2024_GoldieIntro1_Cu.value: They must have made a mistake at the animal shelter! I think I need to give them a call...
